paper_metadata.title: High strength and ductility of Ti3Zr1.5NbVAl0.25 refractory high entropy alloy by laser direct energy deposition via a single cold deformation and annealing cycle

evidence.quote: Here, the single-phase body centered cubic (BCC) structured Ti3Zr1.5NbVAl0.25 RHEA with superior specific strength and ductility were developed by laser direct energy deposition and cold-rolling.

The cold-rolled sheet is annealed at 600 °C for 1 h (the annealed sample is represented by CR-600).

The process parameters for L-DED in the production of dense Ti3Zr1.5NbVAl0.25 alloy were as follows: laser power of 2000 W, laser scanning speed of 8 mm/s, overlap ratio of 40 % and zigzag pattern. The L-DED environment was maintained in an argon atmosphere with an oxygen content of less than 20 ppm.

the CR-900 sample exhibits a notable fine equiaxed crystal size, with an average grain size of 35 μm
the CR-900 sample has a specific strength of 173.1 MPa cm3 g-1 and greater ductility
the contribution of solid solution strengthening to the overall yield strength is estimated to be ~709 MPa
Using Eq. (3), the GBs effect of the alloy is estimated to be ~46 MPa

These microstructural features play a critical role in continuous strain hardening, effectively delaying premature necking in the CR-900 sample.
